jobs.description: WIR SUCHEN IM AUFTRAG EINES SPEDITIONSUNTERNEHMENS (Großraum Bremen) Fokus: Air & Sea Wachstum & Internationalisierung im Mittelstand Sie möchten unternehmerisch gestalten und ein mittelständisches Logistikunternehmen in eine erfolgreiche Zukunft führen? Sie verfügen über langjährige Erfahrung in der Speditions- und Logistikbranche, bevorzugt im Bereich Air & Sea – und verstehen, wie operative Exzellenz, wirtschaftliche Verantwortung und moderne Führung zusammenspielen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen. Für ein Speditionsunternehmen suchen wir eine Führungspersönlichkeit, die die Zukunft des Unternehmens – mit Blick auf operativer Prozessexzellenz, Wachstum, Struktur und Internationalisierung – aktiv gestaltet. Über das Unternehmen: Das Unternehmen ist ein etabliertes, inhabergeführtes Speditions- und Logistikunternehmen mit umfangreichem Portfolio und Fokus auf Kontraktlogistik, Landverkehre und Luft- und Seefracht. Die besondere Stärke des Unternehmens liegt in der Kombination aus langjährigen Kundenbeziehungen, operativer Umsetzungskompetenz und authentischem Unternehmertum. In den vergangenen Jahren hat sich das Unternehmen erfolgreich auf einen klaren Wachstums- und Optimierungspfad begeben. Um die Entwicklung nachhaltig zu sichern und weiter auszubauen, werden Strukturen gezielt angepasst und die zukünftige Wachstumsstrategie durch erfahrene Führungskräfte ergänzt. Wichtige Ziele sind dabei die Digitalisierung, Internationalisierung und Etablierung eines modernen Führungsverständnisses. Im Zuge dieser strategischen Weiterentwicklung schaffen wir eine zusätzliche Top-Management-Position mit Perspektive zur Co-Geschäftsführung – mit dem klaren Fokus auf die operative Abwicklung im Bereich Air & Sea. Hierbei halten Sie dem derzeitigen Gesellschafter im Hinblick auf die reibungslose Funktionsweise des operativen Geschäfts im Bereich Air & Sea den Rücken frei und verfügen über eine ausgeprägte Umsetzungskompetenz. Oder dass Menschen bereits heute etwas für ihre Gesundheit tun, um morgen möglichst lange fit, beweglich und voller Lebensfreude zu bleiben. Genau dafür steht K-Active. Und vielleicht bald auch du! Seit über 25 Jahren begleiten wir Therapeuten, Ärzte, Trainer, Sportler und gesundheitsbewusste Menschen – vom Freizeitsportler bis zum Olympiateilnehmer. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der Therapie, Rehabilitation, Regeneration, Diagnostik, Prävention und Longevity. Was uns antreibt? Menschen zu helfen, ihre Gesundheit, Beweglichkeit und Lebensqualität zu verbessern – und ihre persönlichen Ziele zu erreichen. Dafür stehen wir mit innovativen Produkten, neuen Ideen, internationaler Erfahrung und einem Team, das mit Herz und Begeisterung zusammenarbeitet. DEINE MISSION BEI UNS Wir suchen keinen Menschen, der einfach nur Beiträge postet. Wir suchen einen kreativen Kopf, der unsere Begeisterung nach außen trägt. Du erkennst spannende Geschichten, entwickelst Ideen und machst aus unseren Produkten, Partnerschaften und Projekten Inhalte, die Menschen wirklich erreichen. Das kannst du bei uns bewegen: Du entwickelst kreative Social-Media-Inhalte für Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn und weitere Kanäle. Du erstellst Fotos, Videos, Reels und Kampagnen, die begeistern und echten Mehrwert bieten. Du begleitest unsere Sportpartner, Therapeuten, Veranstaltungen und Produktneuheiten. Du gestaltest Marketingaktionen, Newsletter und Inhalte für unsere Onlineshops mit. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, erkennst Trends und entwickelst unsere Kommunikation weiter. Du analysierst den Erfolg unserer Maßnah

Perform visual and workmanship inspections, including verification of surface condition, coating, cleaning, marking, damage, and assembly quality. Identify, segregate, and report non-conforming products and support technical clarification, containment, and disposition activities. Create and improve inspection checklists, measurement plans, and inspection instructions for incoming and final inspection. Develop and optimize measurement programs using applicable metrology software and equipment. Support supplier quality requests, source-related investigations, and supplier qualification activities with inspection

jobs.title: Founding Engineer (gn) – Hardware & Bioengineering, Munich
jobs.description: About Cellsor Cameras digitized vision. Microphones digitized sound. Smell is the one major sense we still can't capture, measure or transmit reliably. Cellsor is building the sensor that changes that. We replicate the mammalian olfactory epithelium outside the body – living olfactory tissue on microelectrode arrays – and read it out with machine learning. The result is a sensor that detects chemicals the way a nose does, with the breadth and sensitivity that conventional gas sensors lack. Applications span flavor and fragrance, defense and security, medical diagnostics, food quality and industrial monitoring. We are a VC-backed Tufts University spin-out with a working proof of principle and paid industry pilots, with teams in Boston (biology) and Munich (engineering). About the role As our first engineer in Munich, you develop the instrument that keeps our living sensor tissue alive and samples the air it analyzes. You take it from today's lab setup to a field-ready prototype at a customer site within 18 months. What you will do: Define the instrument architecture, then build prototypes across mechanics, fluidics and housing Develop automated media exchange that keeps cells viable for weeks to months Build the air path: sampling, filtration and controlled delivery of odorants to the sensor Integrate sensors, pumps and controllers for monitoring and automation Test and iterate with our Boston biology team Contribute to grant applications What you need to succeed Must-have: MSc or PhD in mechanical, biomedical or bioengineering, or a related field Built a lab or medical device from concept to working prototype CAD, rapid prototyping, and electronics integration Comfortable with uncertainty: you make progress without a defined path and decide what to build next Hands-on and self-directed – you'd rather test an idea on the bench than discuss it for a week Fluent English; German a plus Nice-to-have: Cell culture, perfusion or microfluidics Gas handling or air sampling S

jobs.title: Agentic Platform Engineer (gn) @ AI Venture, Berlin
jobs.description: This is an Atlantic portfolio venture. About the Venture AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up. Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around. We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task. Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one. Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it. About the Role As one of our first platform engineers, you will build the foundations that every product feature depends on: the gateway and router, usage and billing systems, customer key management and the European infrastructure underneath. Much of that platform is still taking shape. Working directly with the founder, CTO and founding AI engineer, you will help turn early architectural decisions into systems that remain reliable as the product grows. You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. In a team this small, building and running the system belong together.

If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you. You’ll own the products and workflows that turn fund and portfolio data into correct, trusted reporting that’s ready to send to investors. Du weißt, wie Kubernetes auf eigener Hardware läuft und was passiert, wenn es das nicht tut. Launches und Piloten Du planst und begleitest den Start neuer Produkte, Features und Partnerprojekte. Wer liefert was

We empower doctors, therapists, and nursing staff to care for patients as quickly, effectively, and sustainably as possible. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK. Role Summary PLOS is a nonprofit Open Access publisher with an ambitious mission: to help transform research communication so that science can be shared, understood and used more effectively.  Research publishing is changing rapidly. Researchers expectations are changing. Technology is creating possibilities that didn t exist a few years ago. And at PLOS we re rethinking some of the services, systems and assumptions that have shaped scholarly publishing for decades.   That means there are interesting product  problems  to solve - not just features to deliver.   You ll take responsibility for a product area and work with designers, engineers and colleagues across PLOS to understand the problems that matter, work out where we can make the greatest difference and help the team learn its way towards good solutions.   You ll be joining active product teams working on significant problems and will have plenty of opportunity to shape what we do and how we do it.     How we work   We want our product teams to be curious, evidence-led and comfortable with uncertainty.   We don t expect a Product Manager to arrive with all the answers. We do expect them to ask good questions.   You ll use continuous discovery alongside delivery: spending time with users, looking at data, understanding the wider service, identifying assumptions and finding practical ways to test them.   You ll help the team break large problems into smaller things we can learn from, rather than waiting until everything is known before we release something.   And you ll make the team s thinking visible - explaining what we re trying to achieve, what we ve learned, what we re uncertain about and why we re making the choice

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: About Kernel Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this? Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier. Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust. Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it. Ops, data and revenue teams at Gong, Legora, Mistral, Canva and Checkout already use Kernel on their own systems. Agents are next, and there will be far more of them. We have raised $20M from top VCs and operators at Plaid, OpenAI, Slack and others, and we are growing 5x YoY. The Role You'll be a player-coach engineering leader with a spike in technical strategy, you'll own engineering delivery for your team end-to-end - from developing exceptional engineers to solving some of our most difficult engineering problems & setting technical direction. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll spend roughly 20% of your time contributing code and 80% leading your team, with that ratio shifting as we scale. Key Responsibilities Build, hire, and develop a high-performing engineering team Help set technical direction and architecture decisions Work with the engineering to tackle some of our most difficult problems Own engineering delivery with

jobs.description: About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. Our EDEN models are trained on BaseData, the world's largest proprietary genomic dataset, with over 10B genes collected through partnerships in more than 30 countries across all seven continents. This gives our AI models access to genetic diversity that doesn't exist in public databases, and enables EDEN to design cell and gene therapies, enzymes, and peptides directly from information about a disease. Our pipeline of EDEN-designed therapeutics, beginning with in vivo cell therapy, is advancing towards clinical development. In September 2026 we closed an oversubscribed $140M Series C led by S32, with participation from NVIDIA, Anthropic's Anthology Fund, Catalio, European Tech Collective, Firebrand River Capital, King Philanthropies, NATO Innovation Fund, NVentures (NVIDIA's venture arm), Redalpine, Rockefeller Foundation, Singular, Sovereign AI and True Ventures. We have offices and labs in London and Boston, we partner with biopharma companies and academic institutions worldwide, and our work has been recognised by Fast Company's Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Biotech, the FT-backed Sifted AI100 list of Europe's leading AI startups as well as Barclays Eagle Labs Ones to watch, AI100. At Basecamp Research, we pride ourselves on being a lean collaborative and global team with extremely specialist and unique skills. Our biologists, engineers, ML scientists and field explorers are united by a sense of adventure and the belief that AI, biology and data, will result in new medicines for patients who have few options today. jobs.title: Special Projects Lead - Category Expansion
jobs.description: Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain? The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual and broken. Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice. We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it. Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion that can grade, price and categorise items with just a photo. Turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable and tradable global inventory layer. Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates. Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally. We're looking for people who want to build something that matters and move fast doing it. Sounds good? Keep reading. About the Role We're hiring a Special Projects Lead to take Fleek's new category bets from thesis to proven economics. Each is a new business line that could add £5M+ in GMV, opening a new supply category or a new sourcing geography for the marketplace. Here's what makes these bets unusually winnable. Fleek already owns the demand. Most of the live bets sell to buyers

jobs.title: Talent Director
jobs.description: About OLIX AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance. The Role The Talent Director owns how OLIX finds, wins and hires the people who will build it. You will take a talent function built for around 200 people and make it one that carries us confidently to 1,000, across London, Bristol, Austin, San Francisco and Toronto, without lowering the bar on a single hire. This is a hands on leadership role. You will personally lead our most senior and executive searches, and close people who are not looking. Many of the people we need exist in pools of a few dozen worldwide: III-V device engineers, advanced packaging architects, optical interconnect specialists, AI software engineers, silicon leaders who have taken a chip to production. Hiring them is a precision problem, not a volume one. You will build a team of recruiters as sharp as the engineers they hire, and set an AI strategy for recruiting that changes how we decide, not just how fast we work. The best argument wins here, and we expect you to make it, welcome challenges to it, and change your mind when the evidence says so. We build companies from zero, putting capital, our own team, and hands-on operating time behind a founding team before there's a product or even a name. The studio's work spans wherever a market and the data or infrastructure underneath it are broken enough to justify building the fix from scratch. About The General Data Corporation General Data is the infrastructure for licensing proprietary data: The platform runs the whole deal from request to delivery, with privacy checks, rights evidence and contracts built in. The vision is to become the system of record between AI and the world’s private data, the data that has never been published but that the next generation of AI depends on. On one side are enterprises, AI labs and robotics teams that need real-world data, and on the other are companies whose operations generate it. General Data is the data infrastructure for the modern economy, connecting every party so that data can be licensed safely, transparently and at scale. Why this is a unique opportunity AI has absorbed the public internet, and its next gains will come from private, real-world data, yet today these deals still run on email, WhatsApp and brokers, with no visibility into what was checked, who holds the rights, or whether personal data was removed. Labs are already paying for this data, and regulation like GDPR and the EU Data Act makes a trusted, verifiable layer a necessity. General Data is VC-backed and looking for its technical co-founder. Together with Founder & CEO Louai Allani , you will own the product and architecture, shape the company’s direction as an equal partner and build the team from the ground up. jobs.description: Our common vision Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Our AI-powered attribution creates real transparency, showing how digital advertising investments perform across channels. On that foundation, we optimize budgets so our customers can sustainably grow their bottom line. We support leading European brands across e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance & energy, and many other industries in making their marketing smarter, more efficient, and more impactful. About the role Nexoya runs fully automated, AI-driven budget optimizations and simulations for enterprise marketing portfolios across many ad channels. Every result that reaches a customer must be correct, explainable and on time. As our ML Intern, you make sure it is: you monitor pipeline health, check the quality of predictions, optimizations and simulations, investigate anomalies and turn recurring manual checks into reliable tooling. You work closely with our ML engineers and Customer Success, and you see directly how your work shapes our customers' budget decisions. Your responsibilities Monitor the automation and assure result quality Monitor the automated prediction, optimization and simulation pipelines across customer portfolios and track run health, completeness and timeliness. Verify that predictions, optimization proposals and simulation results meet our quality standards before they reach customers: budget shifts, expected KPI changes, channel constraints and funnel-level effects. Investigate failed or unexpected runs, identify the root cause (data, configuration or model) and resolve it or escalate it with a clear diagnosis. Assure the quality of results over time Define and maintain plausibility checks for optimization and simulation results, for example for budget planning, seasonal shifts or new channel tests. Make sure results are consistent and explainable, so that customers and account managers can trust them without manual checks. Compare optimize

Als Teamleider geef je hiërarchisch leiding ben je een voorbeeld in de Envalior gedragsnormen en ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verbeteren van de teamprestatie en de individuele prestaties door het toepassen van Envalior HR-instrumenten. Aansturen van operators en coördineren van werkzaamheden tijdens de dienst. Operations Owner binnen Manufex werkprocessen. Beheren van utility systemen en werkvergunningen. As an IT Servicedesk Engineer (Senior), you are the first point of contact for employees across our international organization. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Data Engineer Shiftbase is building the self-driving assistant for shift-based businesses across Europe. Our customers range from independent restaurants in Amsterdam to multi-location retailers in München, and they spend hours every week on scheduling, time tracking, payroll prep, and HR admin. We want to take that work off their plate and eventually do it for them. Underneath that product vision sits a data challenge. Insight, automation, and AI all depend on data people can trust, and the foundation for it doesn't exist yet. You will build the foundation that fixes this. What you'll do Architect the warehouse. Design and own our BigQuery and Dataform warehouse from the ground up. Build a layered, well-modeled foundation, medallion staging through marts, not only the models that sit on top. Ask every day whether the whole company can trust and reuse it. Make the data flow reliably. Build ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads, orchestration, and retries, so pipelines run on time without anyone watching them. Ship monitored pipelines that hold up in production. Take the transform layer. jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: De uitdaging Onze klant ontwikkelt high-tech embedded systemen die extreem betrouwbaar, veilig en performant moeten zijn. Je werkt in een omgeving waar innovatie de standaard is en waar jouw code direct invloed heeft op hardware, sensoren, controllers en real-time verwerking. We zoeken engineers die met plezier de diepte ingaan: van low-level drivers tot robust architecture en van integratie tot performance-optimalisatie. Wat ga je doen? Als Embedded Software Engineer werk je via GradeMatch binnen een multidisciplinair engineeringteam dat software, elektronica en systeemarchitectuur combineert. Je ontwikkelt embedded software in C en C++, analyseert hardware-interactie, werkt met RTOS-omgevingen en draagt bij aan nieuwe en bestaande modules. Je krijgt te maken met complexe systemen, nieuwe productfeatures, protocollen, edge computing, testscenario’s en integratie met high-end apparatuur. Hoe je impact maakt Je implementeert embedded softwaremodules in C en C++ volgens hoge kwaliteitseisen en werkt aan drivers, interfaces, communicatiestromen en configuratiecomponenten. Je stelt duidelijke requirements op en denkt actief mee over designkeuzes, terwijl je samen met andere engineers high-level en low-level architectuurvoorstellen uitwerkt. Daarnaast test en review je code op betrouwbaarheid, performance en stabiliteit en werk je nauw samen met hardware engineers om een correcte integratie te waarborgen. Je begeleidt de live-gang, validatie en nazorg binnen de embedded omgeving en documenteert code, flows, architectuur en testresultaten zorgvuldig. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: De wereld om ons heen verandert razendsnel. Wat vandaag nieuw is, kan morgen alweer achterhaald zijn. Bij PuurData krijg je de kans om samen met collega’s te werken aan slimme oplossingen voor onze klanten. Zo kun je bijvoorbeeld bedrijven helpen met het inzichtelijk maken van hun data of meedenken over hoe ze veiliger met hun data om kunnen gaan. Je helpt onze klanten vooruit door ze mee te nemen in nieuwe technologieën en te laten zien waar bijvoorbeeld AI daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegt. Op deze manier kun je zowel kleine, maar ook grote en veeleisende bedrijven helpen met oplossingen die kritisch zijn voor hun bedrijfsvoering. Tenslotte zorgen wij er samen voor dat jij continu blijft groeien en op de hoogte bent van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen. Wat ga je doen? Als Data Engineer bij PuurData ben je meer dan een technicus. Je bent een consultant die klanten helpt om meer waarde uit hun data te halen. PuurData werkt met platformen zoals Elastic en AWS, en bedient klanten op het gebied van zoektechnologie, observability, security en AI. Jij bent degene die die oplossingen tot leven brengt. Je start bij de klant. Je inventariseert de vraag: wat willen ze met hun data? Gaat het om betere zoekfunctionaliteit, real-time inzicht in systemen, of security en threat detection? Klanten weten vaak dat er iets niet klopt. Data is traag, er is geen inzicht, of er zijn performance problemen. Maar ze weten niet altijd hoe ze het moeten oplossen. Jij helpt dat helder te maken. Vervolgens ga je samen met de klant naar de juiste oplossing toe. Je vertaalt de behoefte naar een concrete aanpak en implementeert die van A tot Z: van het inrichten van de datastroom tot het opleveren van dashboards en inzichten. Geen dag is hetzelfde. De use cases lopen uiteen van zoekoplossingen en business process monitoring tot SIEM-implementaties en data engineering-pipelines. Dat geeft je veel vrijheid in de invulling van je werk. jobs.title: Test Engineer
jobs.description: Analyseren, (functioneel) testen, debuggen… Waar houd jij je als test engineer bij ons eigenlijk niet mee bezig!? Als test engineer is iedere werkdag anders. De complexe producten die wij maken voor onze klanten, maken gebruik van proces- en functionele testers. Uitval hiervan wordt geanalyseerd en testers worden gedebugged. Dit wordt in samenwerking met ons Test Development team gedaan, die onze testers hebben ontwikkeld, gebouwd én vrijgegeven. Het grootste gedeelte van je werkdag ben je bezig met praktische en analytische werkzaamheden. Een greep uit je werkzaamheden als test engineer: Testen van prototypes: in een losse testopstelling op je werkbank meten. Debuggen/functioneel testen in Labview: bijvoorbeeld na uitval op de functionele tester. Sustainable analyseren: uitzoeken wat er is gebeurd, waarom is dit gebeurd en hoe we dit in de toekomst kunnen voorkomen. Reparatie van uitgevallen producten; uitval na o.a. AOI, Flying probe of functionele testers of retouren vanuit de klant. Interne overleggen: bijvoorbeeld met je collega’s van de afdeling Quality, Engineering etc. Technisch challengen : niet alleen bij Benchmark collega’s, maar soms ook bij de klant. Jij zorgt in alles wat je doet voor de juiste analyses en verwerking hiervan. Hierdoor worden afwijkingen gefilterd en gesignaleerd, worden root-causes vastgesteld en opgelost en blijft het productieproces continu verbeteren. Wat biedt Benchmark? Werken bij Benchmark betekent werken in een dynamische werkomgeving. Je werkt in een zelfstandig team waar jouw initiatieven en ideeën zeer op prijs worden gesteld. Het team bestaat uit 13 collega’s en is een hechte groep waarin iedereen bereid is om elkaar te helpen. jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer
jobs.description: Ben jij een Senior Quality Engineer die verder kijkt dan het oplossen van afwijkingen? Iemand die kwaliteit ziet als een stuurinstrument en het voortouw neemt in structurele verbetering? Dan bieden wij jou een rol waarin je écht het verschil maakt. Als Senior Quality Engineer ben je een sleutelspeler in het naar een hoger volwassenheidsniveau brengen van onze kwaliteitsperformance. Je acteert proactief, signaleert risico’s vóórdat ze problemen worden en stuurt op duurzame oplossingen. Je bent geen volger van processen, maar mede‑vormgever van hoe kwaliteit wordt geborgd, verbeterd en beleefd wordt bij ons. Een belangrijk onderdeel van je rol is het inhoudelijk en methodisch leiden van verbetertrajecten, waaronder het aanjagen en begeleiden van het Quality Improvement Team (QIT‑proces). Je fungeert daarbij als coach, challenger en inhoudelijk geweten. Wat ga je, onder andere, doen? Proactief analyseren van kwaliteitsafwijkingen, trends en risico’s om structurele, systeemgedreven oorzaken bloot te leggen. Leiden van root cause analyses en borgen van effectieve, duurzame CAPA’s. Initiëren, ontwikkelen en borgen van kwaliteitsstandaarden, procedures en werkinstructies. Voorbereiden, uitvoeren en doelgericht benutten van interne en externe audits. Analyseren en vertalen van kwaliteits‑KPI’s naar concrete verbeteracties en besluitvorming. Regie voeren op kwaliteit binnen NPI‑projecten, inclusief kritische beoordeling van deliverables en klantspecificaties. Waar maak jij het verschil? Je werkt intensief samen met productie, engineering, supply chain en klanten, maar neemt vooral ook inhoudelijk leiderschap. Je stelt de juiste vragen, doorbreekt reactieve patronen en helpt de organisatie om kwaliteit voorspelbaar, robuust en toekomstbestendig in te richten. Binnen het team krijg je ruimte om verbeterinitiatieven te initiëren, anderen daarin mee te nemen en samen te bepalen waar jouw expertise de meeste waarde toevoegt. Kortom: een rol voor een professional die eigenaarschap

Heb jij het vermogen om interne verandering te realiseren én kansen te benutten bij onze technische klanten? Wij zoeken een System Architect Medical productontwikkeling die een sleutelrol speelt in onze projecten voor medische klanten. Je loopt voorop in productontwikkeling en technologieën. Zoek je een plek waar jouw ervaring in de high‑tech en semiconductor‑industrie écht tot zijn recht komt? Dan nodigen we je graag uit om verder te lezen. Als Senior Design Engineer bij Benchmark krijg je volop ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen binnen het vakgebied Electrical Engineering . Binnen het team ben jij verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen, implementeren en verifiëren van complexe digitale elektronica . Je levert een inhoudelijke bijdrage aan het project en borgt de technische kwaliteit van jouw ontwerpen. Wat zijn, onder andere, je verantwoordelijkheden? You will contribute to the integration of mmWave converter functionality, development of calibration-related features, firmware verification, and enhancement of VNA measurement capabilities up to 170 GHz. You are comfortable working with large existing software architectures and can effectively analyze, modify, and extend complex instrument software while maintaining product quality and performance. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong C++ development capabilities with practical understanding of RF measurements, calibration concepts, and automated verification methodologies. jobs.title: Werkstudent Industrialisatie Engineering PCBA
jobs.description: Als Werkstudent Industrialisatie Engineering PCBA ondersteun je onze Industrialisatie Engineers bij het introduceren van nieuwe producten. Je helpt bij praktische en administratieve werkzaamheden, zodat producten goed voorbereid de productie in gaan. Jij brengt bij ons in de praktijk wat je tijdens je studie leert! Spreken we je snel? Jij draagt bij aan het voorbereiden, vastleggen en verbeteren van productieprocessen door onder andere werkinstructies op te stellen, technische documentatie te beheren en product- en procesgegevens te verwerken. Daarnaast ondersteun je tijdens de eerste productiebouw, controleer je onderdelen en documentatie en help je bij het voorbereiden van bedrading, tooling en werkplekken. Wat ga je doen? jobs.title: IAM Platform Engineer - PKI & Cloud Native
jobs.description: Wil jij bouwen aan de veilige basis van een modern identity platform? Binnen het IAM Platform team van CBS zoeken we een engineer die zich richt op PKI, certificaten, machine identities en cloud-native security binnen een open en toekomstbestendig platformlandschap. Bouw jij hier aan mee? Waar jij het verschil maakt In deze rol werk je aan de technische fundamenten onder veilige toegang en betrouwbare machine-to-machine communicatie. Je ontwerpt en bouwt een moderne, geautomatiseerde PKI-dienst die de huidige Microsoft-gebaseerde root en intermediate CA vervangt. Daarbij combineer je een sterke security-achtergrond met een platformengineering-mindset, waarin GitOps, Infrastructure as Code en self-service voor DevOps- en applicatieteams centraal staan. Je werkt op het snijvlak van identity, security en platformengineering. Daarbij: ontwerp en implementeer je een nieuwe PKI-architectuur met root- en intermediate CA’s op basis van open standaarden, bij voorkeur met open source technologie; migreer je de bestaande Microsoft-PKI gefaseerd naar de nieuwe oplossing, met minimale impact op productieomgevingen, op basis van Cloud-native, Open-source software; richt je geautomatiseerd certificaat lifecycle management in voor issuance, renewal, revocation en rotatie, zodat infrastructuur en applicaties zichzelf van certificaten kunnen voorzien; bouw je PKI als platformdienst met GitOps-workflows, Infrastructure as Code en API-gedreven of self-service provisioning via platforms en CI/CD; integreer je PKI met Kubernetes en containerplatformen, hybride en cloudomgevingen, on-premises workloads en de IAM- en Keycloak-infrastructuur, waaronder TLS-certificaten, mTLS-clients, truststores en certificaatgebaseerde authenticatie; leg je architectuurkeuzes, standaarden, rollen en verantwoordelijkheden vast en borg je security, compliance en continuïteit, waaronder ISO 27001 en relevante overheidsrichtlijnen. Je toekomstige collega's Je wordt onderdeel van het IAM Platform team van CBS.

jobs.description: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the  FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market. Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from  more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns. Team Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t.  We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require.  Raisin is available in many European countries, each with its own tax rules and reporting duties. As new regulations come to our platform, we make sure Raisin complies. You will lead a cross-functional team and work closely with Legal, Compliance, Country Management, Product Operations, Customer Service, Data, and external tax and banking partners. Our goal is for customers to trust that their tax is right, find it easy to manage, use the tax allowances they are entitled to, and have peace of mind. Your Responsibilities Y

Our AI-powered software makes complex production environments editable, interactive, and collaborative, turning manufacturing planning into something anyone can engage with, not just the experts. We’re looking for a 3D Data Operator to help power the foundation of our digital factory experiences. No point cloud experience needed, just an eye for detail and curiosity about 3D. In this role, you'll work at the intersection of 3D reality and AI, transforming raw point cloud data into accurate digital twins of real-world production environments. From data preparation to model generation and delivery, you'll help ensure quality, consistency, and continuous improvement across our data pipeline. Run basic pipeline commands for data preparation and AI processing. Configure and verify model outputs to ensure quality, consistency, and usability for downstream applications (e.g., Nvidia Omniverse, Siemens Plant Simulation and others). Collaborate with AI-assisted tools to validate and correct automated results. Flag and troubleshoot anomalies or edge cases in raw or processed data, and document issues clearly (e.g., as Git issues). Track and report your weekly processing output. Continuously improve workflows and documentation based on team feedback and real-world challenges. jobs.title: Senior C++ Performance Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: About the role At Agile Robots, we build powerful software frameworks to orchestrate complex robotic systems and solve challenging tasks. The solutions are sold to various international customers to enable them to control their robotic work cells. Smooth integration and scalable deployment are key goals.  AgileCore is meant to be a scalable platform that supports multiple projects in parallel. That only works if the platform underneath scales with it - if it stays fast, thread-safe, and diagnosable as projects, devices, and operating conditions multiply. We are looking for a Senior C++ Performance Engineer to join our AgileCore Runtime core team. This is a T-shaped role in a small senior team: you are a full member of the core team first - contributing to the Runtime, reviewing contributions from the teams that build on our platform, and sharing our support and release duties - and within the team, you own the performance and stability practice as your specialization. On the specialization side, you will drive the performance of the Runtime core - the Blackboard, the Behavior Engine and the execution paths beneath them - make the system provably thread-safe under load, and make failures in the field fast to diagnose. You own the practice: the methodology, the tooling, the benchmarks, the audits and the education. You work hand in hand with the platform architect, who owns the performance budgets and hot-path interface contracts at the architecture level - you turn those budgets into measured, enforced reality and shape them with your findings. You set the standard for performance, concurrency and troubleshooting, and raise the team s ability to meet it without slowing feature development down. This is a shipping role, not a research role: success is measured in merged improvements, closed field escalations and green regression gates - not in microbenchmark leaderboards. Who We Are CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. The CrowdSec solution is used in 180+ countries, it is a well-known, unique, collaborative, open-source security solution that protects hundreds thousands of users. We are animated by a mission: making the Internet a safer place, all together. Role As an Account Executive (AE), you will work with the Sales team to help them scale, create new opportunities, interact with them, convert them to Leads, and take the accounts to signature. This will be done in collaboration with the BDRs, presales, Marketing, and Support teams to ensure the most pleasant customer journey. jobs.title: ML Platform Engineer
jobs.description: About us Bleu Robotics is an AI company developing universal AI software for the deployment of advanced robots , humanoids, mobile manipulators, and industrial arms, in real factories. The convergence of humanoid robotics and modern AI is one of the most significant technical opportunities of the decade, and most of the work today still happens in research settings. We are building the software layer required to bring it into operational use. We have a strong ambition to become the next Microsoft to run on every industrial humanoid. We have closed our pre-seed round with Top-tier fund to deploy our robot in Tier 1 manufacturing facilities. We are looking for deeply passionate scientists who can help us push the frontier and build a major lab in physical AI. Our vision To enable a robot to learn a new industrial task from a few demonstrations and operate autonomously, with under one hour between the start of the demonstration and the start of deployment. This objective shapes our roadmap and every technical decision we make. THE ROLE We are hiring an ML Platform Engineer to put our robot learning stack in the cloud and own the full stack. The platform will let customers run our learning pipelines on their own data as a hosted service; its exact scope will evolve with the product. You will be the first engineer at Bleu Robotics with cloud expertise. The scope covers infrastructure, training and inference services, the web front end, security, and cost. The choice of cloud provider and web framework is open; you will make it with the team. The role is based in Paris and is on-site. BACKGROUND We are equally interested in two kinds of background: software or ML platform engineer who has built and operated a cloud service that runs training or inference jobs on data uploaded by users (e.g., an ML platform team, an MLOps product, a SaaS that runs compute on customer data). backend or full-stack engineer with solid DevOps experience who has shipped a web product on a major

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: About the Role We’re looking for a top-tier Forward Deployed Engineer to join Linkup and work hand-in-hand with our founders, customers, and partners. You'll be part of the founding FDE team at Linkup Your mission: help leading AI companies, developers, and enterprises integrate Linkup’s AI-ready search APIs into their products - and shape how the next generation of AI agents connects to the web. This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll operate at the intersection of engineering, GTM, and customer success , turning technical integrations into insights that drive our product roadmap, marketing narratives, and outbound strategy. You’ll be the connective bridge between what customers build with Linkup and how we tell that story to the world. What You’ll Do Work directly with customers and partners to design, prototype, and deploy integrations of Linkup’s APIs into real-world agentic systems. Participate in pre-sales efforts - technical discovery, proof-of-concept design, demo environments. Collaborate cross-functionally with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure performance and reliability at scale. Partner with the GTM Engineer and DevRel team to turn customer learnings into automation, tutorials, and playbooks. Identify and implement technical integrations with our other partners in the value chain (workflow orchestration, AI frameworks, etc.) Translate complex technical concepts into clear explanations for both developers and business audiences. Why This Role Matters Every integration you build helps define how AI systems connect to live, trusted information . You’ll operate on the frontier between customers and product - bringing the voice of the field into everything we build and say. Your work will inform: The stories we tell in marketing. The use cases we automate in our GTM systems. The features we prioritize in our roadmap. If you love blending engineering with impact - building things users actually depend on: this role is for you. You’re a Great Fit

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Web + Infrastructure)
jobs.description: Searoutes makes the emissions data that shippers use to run and reduce their logistics. It is an operational problem before it is an environmental one, and in our hands it is mostly an engineering one. We are hiring a senior engineer who works across our web frontend and our infrastructure — the same two codebases, in the same week. Someone who ships a product screen on Monday, changes an identity-provider flow on Wednesday, and considers those the same job. We are looking for a broad profile rather than a specialist. The next year is mostly platform work with a user-facing edge — user management, API gateway management, payments, SEO, and a great deal of compliance, GDPR and ISO 27001. If you are passionate about the environment, proactive and pragmatic in getting things done, and love to work in a complex but fascinating industry where you learn every day — then this is the place for you. The work in front of us Some of the items on our tech roadmap for the coming year. Bets are picked a cycle at a time and shared out, so you would take the ones that suit you and grow into the rest. Product and marketing UI in React — multi-brand, WCAG AA, strong on technical SEO, fast enough to hold a performance budget. User management and identity — Keycloak realms, organisation hierarchies, partner brokering, and the entitlement model in the app. API gateway work in APISIX — routes, plugins and auth policy as code. Payments and billing. ISO 27001 and GDPR — access control, change management, audit logging, observability and alerting, consent and retention. The infrastructure underneath — Pulumi in TypeScript, Docker Swarm on Hetzner, Cloudflare at the edge, Tailscale for all engineer and CI access. Third-party integrations — usually the seam between two systems that were never designed to meet. Nobody arrives fluent in all of that, and we are not expecting it. jobs.description: Why Mozilla Mozilla Corporation is a non-profit-backed technology company that has helped shape the internet for the better over the past 25 years. We’re the makers of Firefox , the privacy-focused web browser used by more than 225 million people around the world each month. As we look to the future, we’re working to shape the next 25 years of the internet—one that’s built for people, not just for profit. Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the 501(c) non-profit Mozilla Foundation , meaning we’re accountable not to shareholders, but to our mission. Alongside thousands of contributors and collaborators around the world, Mozillians design, build, and maintain open-source software that empowers people to use the internet on their own terms. About this team and role Firefox Enterprise is seeking a Staff Product Manager to own a major part of our 2027 product roadmap as we grow from our first release into a multi-product enterprise offering. This is a high-impact role for someone who has taken enterprise security products from zero to one. You will set direction, align engineering, design and go-to-market partners, and deliver. This role is ideal for someone who can work across teams with empathy, build trust with a wide range of partners, and move work forward in a practical, low-ego way.
